description: Source code for authentication handlers in a Node.js Express application, implementing GitHub OAuth flow, login, and logout functionalities with auxiliary functions for repository management.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Handles GitHub OAuth callback, exchanges code for access token, sets cookie, and redirects.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates user using access token, checks if first login, creates repo and initial commit if needed.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears authentication cookie and confirms logout.
